api_key.name: API Key
api_key.hint: API key for external clients. Required — requests are rejected when empty. Clients send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>

zh.name: API 密钥
zh.hint: 外部客户端使用的 API 密钥。必填，留空时所有请求将被拒绝。客户端通过 Authorization: Bearer <key> 发送

default_model.name: Default Model
default_model.hint: Select a KiraAI v3 LLM by its stable provider_id:model_id reference. Leave empty to use KiraAI's default LLM

zh.name: 默认模型
zh.hint: 选择 KiraAI v3 LLM，保存稳定的 provider_id:model_id 引用。留空则使用 KiraAI 的默认 LLM

enable_request_log.name: Request Logging
enable_request_log.hint: Log each incoming API request (model, stream, tool usage)

zh.name: 请求日志
zh.hint: 记录每个 API 请求（模型、是否流式、工具使用情况）
